source.author: lucr
source.text: nemo, ut opinor, erit mortali corpore cretus.
source.text_original: nemo, ut opinor, erit mortali corpore cretus.
source.text_english: No one, I think, will have been born with a mortal body.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: quodsi repertorem sapientiae ut deum laudauit ita enim dicit: nemo, ut opinor, erit mortali corpore cretus .
reuse.text_original: quodsi repertorem sapientiae ut deum laudauit — ita enim dicit: nemo, ut opinor, erit mortali corpore cretus .
reuse.text_english: But if he praised the discoverer of wisdom as a god, for he says thus: no one, as I think, will be born with mortal body.
